cohort.selectionBasis: Administrative-level diversity and documented volumes only (count queries); no score, indicator or anomaly was consulted.

buyers.name: ALCALDIA LOCAL DE USAQUEN
buyers.note: Generic shared district NIT; exact entity-name match, NIT kept as-is.

normalization.language: Original Spanish preserved verbatim; no translation.
normalization.currency: COP only; no conversion, no cross-currency sums.
normalization.duration: duraci_n_del_contrato kept as original free text; never parsed into months.
normalization.identityCaveat: Bogotá alcaldías locales share the generic NIT 899999061; Usaquén is matched by exact entity name and the shared NIT is kept as-is. Entity names keep their original noise (//, *, etc.).

joinVerification.verdict: Each SECOP II row already carries its process, contract and supplier declaration; the join is intra-row, so it does not depend on a second source. Completeness is documented above, not assumed.
joinVerification.notClaimed: No offers/proposals and no payment-reconciliation indicators are claimed: this dataset alone does not provide an offers table, and paid amounts are declarations, not audited payments.

limitations: Not exhaustive: only the three announced buyers in the 24-month window.
SECOP II contract rows are declarations; amounts and statuses are not audited payments.
No offers/proposals table was downloaded; competition indicators are NOT claimed.
No country ranking, no currency conversion, no comparison with French cohorts.
No heuristic indicators are implemented for Colombia yet; every row stays 'Not assessed'.

currentIndex.note: Pointer to the active French method; no Colombian scoring exists yet.
